page.layout: One page of text. Above the text, a printer's ornamental band. Centred heading "COROLLARIA." with the numbered theses below it, which are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. Below them, the word "FINIS" in spaced capitals, then a woodcut or engraved vignette (coat of arms or ornament) in the lower centre. No margins with text.
page.notes: The theses under "COROLLARIA." (numbered 1 and 2) are mirrored and inverted. They are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are therefore not transcribed. The word "FINIS" is only partly legible and is given as read. A faint figure at the top right corner, possibly a signature or page number, is too unclear to read and is omitted. The lower centre holds an engraved or woodcut vignette (a crest or ornament), which is not text.
